name: The Firm

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-all-or-nothing-2008-02-p16-19.html.

caption: Jean Cattley's faction, which grows to take in Casey Valentine, Cameron Vessey, Ricky Douglas and Davis Wayne Newton, beats down anyone who resists it, and drops Newton after Iron. Ricky Douglas is thrown out at End Of Days in December 2008 and Primus Allen takes his place. Darryl Devine and Ryan Powell join in March 2010; Jean Cattley, Devine and Powell become the first MAW Trios champions that month, and by April the faction carries the Tag Team titles (through Casey Valentine), the Trios titles and Primus Allen's Invitational trophy. Darryl Devine is gone out west by Summer Showdown in June 2010 and Primus Allen takes his place in the Trios team; Ryan Powell leaves for SWF in July and the Trios titles go at Hotter Than Hot. In August Jean Cattley warns Casey Valentine not to usurp him, and at Where It All Begins Again in October 2010 Cattley beats Valentine for control of the group: Primus Allen powerbombs Valentine and leaves, Jared Johnson leaves as well, and Cattley expels Valentine. The stable is reborn after Spring Fever on 23rd April 2011: Jean Cattley asks Steve Flash to keep his legacy going, and Flash gathers Chance Fortune, Randy Bumfhole and, as its fourth man, Kid Arachnid in the old Firm's dressing room, with a plan to confront the Second Sons and The Fallen. Arachnid, Fortune and Bumfhole win the Trios titles from The Triple Threat at Summernova on 12th August and keep them against The Fallen at Back To School. At All The Leaves Are Brown on 12th October 2011 Chance Fortune brings in Zimmy Bumfhole against the Second Sons, and at Where It All Begins Again the Trios titles go to the Second Sons. After Chance Fortune and Steve Flash leave for the SWF in November, Randy Bumfhole and Kid Arachnid, whom the narrator calls the remnants of The Firm, are left; Kirk Jameson tells Arachnid to strike out on his own.

identity.note: An exact name match with another promotion's own tag team or stable. Each is filed as its own per-promotion row, never merged.

name: C-V-2

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-all-or-nothing-2008-02-p16-19.html.

caption: Cameron Vessey and Casey Valentine, the Firm's tag team, whose name the narrator would like to change to 2CV. They win the MAW Tag Team titles from Morgan & Benning at Iron in August 2009. Cameron Vessey leaves for USPW in March 2010 and Casey Valentine carries the belts on with Jared Johnson.

name: The Canadian Blondes

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/month-2008-01-p1-9.html.

caption: The tag champions Oscar Golden and Flash Savage and their ninja-obsessed partner Hugh Lee, who hold the MAW Tag Team titles until the Beach Blast ladder match. They beat the Bailey Boys at Summernova in August 2010, win the Tag Team titles for a record third time at Fall Of The King in September, and keep them in a four-team ladder match at Where It All Begins Again in October and against Brandon Smith and Joe Benning on a November tour show. They keep the Tag Team titles at Remember November in November 2010 and Season's Beatings, spike-piledrive Brandon Smith after End Of Days, lose the belts to Cattley and Singh at New Year, Old Rivalries on 12th January 2011, beat Smith & Singh at the Invitational and the Internet Favourites at All Or Nothing and lose a rematch to Cattley and Singh at Third Time's The Charm, where Oscar Golden flirts with a girl at ringside. They beat Cattley & Singh for the Tag Team titles at Spring Fever on 23rd April 2011, are brought home drunk by two policemen who are MAW fans, boast on 12th June of being four-time champions, debut the O, Canada! at Summer Showdown and keep the belts through the summer; at Back To School Raphael joins them in a six-man loss to Smith, Singh and Ota. They keep the Tag Team titles against the Young Americans and Smith & Singh on 26th September 2011 and on the 3rd and 24th October tour shows, lose them to Smith & Singh at Where It All Begins Again, beat the West Texas Peacekeepers at Season's Beatings, Peverell and McManus at End Of Days and the Internet Favourites on 5th January 2012, when Kristen Pearce joins them, and say that they have never had their rematch. At Great Lakes Crisis on 2nd March 2012, in the Asylum in Michigan, they cash in their rematch four months after dropping the Tag Team titles and lose to Smith & Singh; they lose to KC Glenn and Jared Johnson at Third Time's The Charm and are in the four-team match at April Showers. In the diary's pages from June to September 2012 they lose the three-way debut of Always Breakin' Hollywood at High Noon on 5th June, beat Spectrum Infinity with O, Canada! at Great Lakes Grand Parade on 9th July, lose to them at Summernova on 5th August with Kristen Pearce at their side, and beat Smith & Singh at South East Grand Parade on 9th August.

name: Perez & Shaffer

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-all-or-nothing-2008-02-p16-19.html.

caption: Frankie Perez and Trent Shaffer, who rematch the Canadian Blondes through the spring, win the MAW Tag Team titles in the Beach Blast ladder match and break up when Perez leaves in September 2008.

name: Shaffer & Grayson

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-fall-of-the-king-2008-09-p54-57.html.

caption: Trent Shaffer and Stevie Grayson, who hold the MAW Tag Team titles from Fall Of The King. They lose the belts to the Gauge Brothers at The Rip Chord Invitational in January 2009; Grayson wins the first Traditional title in March 2009 and the team goes on the back burner. Trent Shaffer and Stevie Grayson are paired again for a title match against Valentine & Johnson at Mother, May I? in May 2010. Billed Grayson & Shaffer from July 2010, they beat Antonio & Raphael at Beach Blast, lose to Ricochet & Sharp at Iron and beat the Canadian Blondes at Back To School.

name: The Masked Patriot and Kashmir Singh

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/month-2008-04-p25-25.html.

caption: A babyface tag team the narrator finds excellent, introduced at Spring Fever against Citizen X and Findlay O'Farraday. With the Masked Patriot now wrestling as "Bulldozer" Brandon Smith, the pair beat Ricochet & Sharp at Summer Showdown in June 2010, and with Fumihiro Ota they are the Trios champions; the diary's own title records call them "Smith & Singh", and the narrator's roster overview says he has "formed a great tag team" for the coming months. As Smith & Singh they lose to the Canadian Blondes at Remember November in November 2010 and at the Invitational, lose to Ford & Speed at All Or Nothing in February 2011, beat Casey Valentine and Antonio on the 25th March tour show and fall to The Triple Threat with Amazing Fire Fly on 4th April. They lose the Tag Team title three-ways of 26th May and 12th July 2011, lose to Ford & Speed at Summernova, squash Team XDW at Iron and, with Fumihiro Ota, beat the Canadian Blondes and Raphael at Back To School; Singh's Broadway enthusiasm and Smith's dyed hair run through July and August. Billed by the diary as Smith & Singh, they lose a three-way at Fall Of The King on 26th September 2011, win the Tag Team titles from the Canadian Blondes at Where It All Begins Again on 26th October, and keep them against the Second Sons, the Dark Raptors and Ford & Speed, Ford & Speed, Firebird and Citizen X and, at The Rip Chord Invitational on 12th January 2012, Ford & Speed and Lockdown; Singh and Smith talk Broadway musicals through the winter. In the diary's pages from February to May 2012 they keep the Tag Team titles against the Canadian Blondes at Great Lakes Crisis, the Second Sons at March Madness and the Second Sons again at May The Force Be With You, and before the Gold Rush match at April Showers agree to be friends and partners entering it but rivals bell to bell. In the diary's pages from June to September 2012 they keep the Tag Team titles in the three-way at High Noon on 5th June, lose them to the Dark Raptors at Summer Showdown on 12th June, and then lose to Always Breakin' Hollywood, the Second Sons, the Canadian Blondes and Ford & Speed, the narrator saying they are doing the job to any heel team that needs a little love; at Back To School on 5th September they stand with Donnie J to protect Sienna LeNoir.

name: Citizen X and Findlay O'Farraday

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/month-2008-04-p25-25.html.

caption: The anarchist and the giant, who beat the Masked Patriot and Kashmir Singh at Spring Fever and were pre-booked months ahead to challenge for the tag titles, a match the diary replaced.

name: The Gauge Brothers

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-end-of-days-2008-12-p72-75.html.

caption: The twins Matthew and Greg Gauge, revealed at End Of Days in December 2008 as the mystery team in a three-way, who win the MAW Tag Team titles from Shaffer & Grayson at The Rip Chord Invitational, lose them to Morgan & Benning at All Or Nothing and fight beside Jay Chord against Rip Chord's side. Greg Gauge leaves after Where It All Begins Again in October 2009 and GCG snap up Matthew Gauge in November; by February 2010 the twins have turned down the narrator's offer to bring them back.

name: Morgan & Benning

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/month-2008-12-p70-71.html.

caption: Thom Morgan and Joe Benning, billed together from End Of Days in December 2008, who beat the Gauge Brothers for the MAW Tag Team titles at All Or Nothing in February 2009, defend them against C-V-2 and the Canadian Blondes and lose them to C-V-2 at Iron in August 2009. They fight Antonio & Raphael to a draw at Fall Of The King in September 2009, lose to Fumihiro Ota and Ultimate Phoenix a month later, beat the Canadian Blondes at March Madness in March 2010, and lose title challenges to Valentine & Johnson in the April Showers three-way and at Spring Fever. They beat Glamour And Devastation at Beach Blast in July 2010, lose to Valentine & Johnson for the Tag Team titles at Iron, beat them in a non-title match at All The Leaves Are Brown, take part in the ladder match at Where It All Begins Again in October and lose to Ford & Speed (Ricochet & Sharp unmasked) at Eleventh Hour in November. They beat Ford & Speed at End Of Days in December 2010 with Morgan's Finest; Thom Morgan, named as a possible cut, loses his last match to VIP Wallace at March Madness in March 2011.

name: Internet Favourites

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-spring-fever-2009-04-p99-102.html.

caption: Max Mayhem and Hugh Lee, who top an internet poll of the company's most entertaining wrestlers in April 2009 and sign Dawn as their manager; they work the Beach Blast three-way and are booked against C-V-2 on the card for Fall Of The King. They lose a first title challenge to C-V-2 at Fall Of The King in September 2009, lose to the Canadian Blondes a month later and to Antonio & Raphael at March Madness in March 2010, and join Fumihiro Ota in April 2010 to challenge The Firm for the Trios titles. They challenge Valentine & Johnson for the Tag Team titles at Beach Blast in July 2010, in a three-way at Back To School and again at Fall Of The King, lose to Antonio & Raphael at All The Leaves Are Brown, and with Amazing Fire Fly lose a trios match to Glamour And Devastation and Nelson Callum at Where It All Begins Again in October. They lose to the Canadian Blondes on the 11th December 2010 tour show and to Firebird and Evil Spirit at Season's Beatings, beat Zeshin Makioka and Yusuke Takahama, Glamour And Devastation and Evil Spirit and Ultimo Soetsu on the 4th January 2011 tour show, lose to the Canadian Blondes at All Or Nothing and to Glamour And Devastation at April Showers, where Findlay O'Farraday clamps a Choke Sleeper on Max Mayhem. They beat Glamour And Devastation on 18th May, Team XDW II on 11th July, Roderick Remus and Nelson Callum on 11th August, Remus and Raphael on 4th September and Jared Johnson and Raphael on 18th September, and lose to Providence and JD Morgan at Hotter Than Hot and to Callum and Raphael on 11th September. They lose to the Canadian Blondes on the 24th October 2011 tour show, to Lockdown at Eleventh Hour on 12th November, when Aaron Andrews springs the match on them, and again to the Blondes on 5th January 2012. They lose to the Second Sons at Third Time's The Charm on 5th March 2012 and are in the four-team Tag Team number-one-contender match at April Showers on 5th April. In the diary's pages for June 2012 the narrator reports that Max Mayhem's contract has lapsed and that Hugh Lee has been re-signed for three months without a partner, so the Internet Favourites are no more.

name: The Watch

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-march-madness-2009-03-p93-95.html.

caption: The stable Ultimate Phoenix presents at March Madness in March 2009 with Morgan & Benning, Kashmir Singh and the Masked Patriot, to police the company's rules and stand against The Firm. At March Madness in March 2010 Ultimate Phoenix, Kashmir Singh and the new Masked Patriot lose the first Trios title match to The Firm, and at Spring Fever in April the stable loses a five-match series to The Firm by three matches to two, which by the stake's terms ends it; Phoenix then attacks his own side with a chair. Ultimate Phoenix, unmasked as Firebird at Summer Showdown in June 2010, chairs his former Watch partners Brandon Smith and Kashmir Singh.

name: Valentine & Johnson

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-april-showers-2010-04-p176-181.html.

caption: Casey Valentine and the indy newcomer Jared Johnson, who take over the MAW Tag Team titles when Cameron Vessey leaves C-V-2 for USPW in March 2010, keep them in a three-way at April Showers, against Morgan & Benning at Spring Fever and against Shaffer & Grayson at Mother, May I?, and stay on the card for Summer Showdown. They keep the belts against the Internet Favourites at Beach Blast in July 2010, Morgan & Benning at Iron and the Internet Favourites and Ricochet & Sharp at Back To School, and lose them to the Canadian Blondes at Fall Of The King in September; Jared Johnson leaves The Firm and the partnership at Where It All Begins Again in October 2010, saying he wants a partner who does not always have one eye on the next big score.

name: Antonio & Raphael

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-spring-fever-2008-04-p26-28.html.

caption: Antonio and his "personal assistant" Raphael, who wrestle as a pair from Spring Fever 2008 on. In September 2009 they fight Morgan & Benning to a draw, at March Madness in March 2010 they beat the Internet Favourites with Raphael's Italian DDT, and in the April Showers three-way they fail to take the tag belts. They lose to Grayson & Shaffer at Beach Blast in July 2010, beat the Internet Favourites with an Italian DDT at All The Leaves Are Brown, and are reduced to spectators in the ladder match for the Tag Team titles at Where It All Begins Again in October. They lose to Brandon Smith and Joe Benning on the 4th December 2010 tour show and to Cattley and Singh for the Tag Team titles at Leap Into The Unknown in February 2011.

name: The Bailey Boys

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-summer-showdown-2010-06-p199-202.html.

caption: TJ and CB Bailey, two lightweights who make their on-screen debut at Summer Showdown in June 2010 by upsetting Primus Allen and Findlay O'Farraday. They lose to the Canadian Blondes at Summernova and to Glamour And Devastation at Back To School, beat Glamour And Devastation at All The Leaves Are Brown, and are in the four-team ladder match for the Tag Team titles at Where It All Begins Again in October 2010. They lose to Ford & Speed at Remember November in November 2010 and to the Canadian Blondes for the Tag Team titles at Season's Beatings; billed as the Bailey Brothers they lose a trios match on 26th January 2011, and both leave MAW in February after eleven shows in nine months.

name: Glamour And Devastation

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/month-2010-07-p205-208.html.

caption: Jefferson Stardust and Findlay O'Farraday, a pair the narrator calls a random pairing to keep Findlay in the picture. After Primus Allen boots his sometime partner in the head backstage at Beach Blast in July 2010, Stardust, with his valet Kristen Pearce, takes the giant on as the heavy lifter ("We'll call ourselves Glamour And Devastation"). They lose to Morgan & Benning at Beach Blast, beat the Bailey Boys at Back To School, lose to them at All The Leaves Are Brown, and with Nelson Callum win a trios match against Amazing Fire Fly and the Internet Favourites at Where It All Begins Again in October 2010. They lose to the Internet Favourites on the 25th December 2010 tour show and in the four-team match on 4th January 2011, beat Matt Hocking and Riley McManus on 4th April, Amazing Fire Fly and Max Mayhem on the 11th and the Internet Favourites at April Showers, with Jefferson Stardust hiding behind Findlay O'Farraday. They lose to Smith & Singh on the 25th April 2011 tour show and to the Internet Favourites on 18th May.

name: Ricochet & Sharp

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-summer-showdown-2010-06-p199-202.html.

caption: The two masked newcomers of The Fallen who work as a tag team: they lose to Smith and Singh at Summer Showdown in June 2010, beat Grayson & Shaffer at Iron in August, trading masks to confuse the referee, lose a three-way for the Tag Team titles to Valentine & Johnson at Back To School and take part in the Eleventh Hour match in November 2010 where, unmasked as Marc Speed and Greg Ford, they make their "debut" as Ford & Speed against Morgan & Benning and win with a Cross Armbreaker. As Ford & Speed they beat the Bailey Boys at Remember November in November 2010, lose to Morgan & Benning at End Of Days, beat Smith & Singh at All Or Nothing in February 2011, lose to Aaron Andrews and Kirk Jameson at Leap Into The Unknown and beat the Young Americans at April Showers. As Ford & Speed they tell the crowd on 12th May 2011 that they are no longer associated with The Fallen but follow its ideals, beat Stevie Grayson and Thomas Morgan that night, are beaten in the Hotter Than Hot three-way, and beat Smith & Singh at Summernova and the West Texas Peacekeepers at Iron with Fallen Chances. As Ford & Speed they beat the West Texas Peacekeepers at Fall Of The King on 26th September 2011 with Fallen Chances, lose to Team OMGsplosion at Eleventh Hour, lose the Tag Team title three-way at Season's Beatings and the title match to Smith & Singh at End Of Days, and beat the Young Americans, Callum and Raphael on 5th January 2012 to earn a shot at the Invitational, where they lose the three-way with Smith & Singh and Lockdown. As Ford & Speed they beat Amazing Fire Fly and Jared Johnson at All Or Nothing on 12th February 2012 and the West Texas Peacekeepers at March Madness, and are in the Spring Fever three-way. As Ford & Speed in the diary's pages from June to September 2012 they lose the three-way at High Noon on 5th June, beat Kid Arachnid and Bradford Peverell at South East Madness, the West Texas Peacekeepers at Summernova and Smith & Singh at Back To School with Fallen Chances, the narrator saying they have lacked direction since being set loose from The Fallen.

name: The Fallen

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-beach-blast-2010-07-p209-211.html.

caption: The group of Firebird, the former Ultimate Phoenix, who preaches that a man must fall to the bottom of his soul before he can understand goodness. Its three masked newcomers, Ricochet, Sharp and Toxin, ambush Fumihiro Ota, Brandon Smith and Kashmir Singh at Mother, May I? in May 2010; Firebird himself breaks with The Watch at Summer Showdown that June, offers The Firm a truce at Beach Blast, and at Eleventh Hour in November has the three unmask as Marc Speed, Greg Ford and Joey Poison, while the newcomer Evil Spirit stands at his side. By April 2011 Firebird lists his followers as Thrash, Greg Ford, Marc Speed, Evil Spirit and JD Morgan, and says that another is to come: Thrash arrives at All Or Nothing in February, JD Morgan is signed to join them, Evil Spirit takes Firebird's side against his former master Fumihiro Ota, and Black Eagle is welcomed back at April Showers. At Mother, May I? on 26th May 2011 Firebird presents the converted Masked Patriot as Providence, the fourth of the four men, with Black Eagle and JD Morgan, who have "something greater"; Greg Ford and Marc Speed still work for the light in their own way. Firebird and Providence beat Aaron Andrews and Kirk Jameson at Summer Showdown, and a Fallen trio led by Morgan loses the Trios titles match against The Firm at Back To School. At Where It All Begins Again on 26th October 2011 Firebird announces, after Kirk Jameson has turned his back on the Fall, that The Fallen will no longer pursue one man and will be everywhere; JD Morgan breaks away to win the All Action title as his own man. With Black Eagle in hospital, Firebird calls in Father Johan at Spring Fever on 12th April 2012 as an ally to strengthen the ranks, and from May The Force Be With You on 5th May the two fight side by side. In the diary's pages from June to September 2012 the name is Firebird's again, with Father Johan, Black Eagle and Providence; at Summer Showdown on 12th June Fumihiro Ota, who from Hotter Than Hot wishes to be called The Great Ota, attacks Donnie J and joins them, and Aaron Andrews shakes Father Johan's hand after swinging the Heavyweight belt into Kirk Jameson's head. The six men come to the ring together at Hotter Than Hot on 5th July, Andrews saying that they will ensure he remains the Heavyweight champion; they fight Kirk Jameson's Knights Templar, Firebird and Ota blindsiding Jameson and Bradford Peverell at South East Grand Parade on 9th August, they lose Father Johan on 12th July, when he and KC Glenn fall from the turnbuckle, and they lose Black Eagle, with Sienna LeNoir, when their contracts expire in September; at Back To School on 5th September Andrews tells them that the group does not work without him as champion.

identity.note: An exact name match with another promotion's own tag team or stable. Each is filed as its own per-promotion row, never merged.

name: Smith, Ota & Singh

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/month-2010-07-p202-203.html.

caption: The "multinational face trio" of "Bulldozer" Brandon Smith, Fumihiro Ota and Kashmir Singh, who beat The Firm for the MAW Trios titles at Hotter Than Hot in July 2010, keep them against Ricochet, Sharp and Toxin at Summernova in August, and against Jared Johnson, Nelson Callum and Roderick Remus at Eleventh Hour in November. The diary's own title records list the team as "Smith, Ota & Singh". They lose the Trios titles to The Triple Threat at Season's Beatings on 12th December 2010, when Firebird distracts Ota; at End Of Days Brandon Smith and Singh, with Jean Cattley, beat Joey Poison and the Canadian Blondes. Smith, Singh and Fumihiro Ota reunite for a six-man at Back To School on 12th September 2011, beating the Canadian Blondes and Raphael when Ota pins Oscar Golden with the Ninja Strike.

name: The Triple Threat

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/month-2010-11-p260-265.html.

caption: Jared Johnson, Roderick Remus and Nelson Callum, formed at Season's Beatings on 12th December 2010, when Johnson, who has been unable to separate Remus and Callum in his search for a partner, names the team after Davis Wayne Newton, a man he replaced in The Firm, and challenges the Trios champions on the spot. They win the Trios titles that night when Firebird distracts Fumihiro Ota and Johnson scores with the Carolina Crossface, beat Amazing Fire Fly and the Internet Favourites in two straight falls at End Of Days, and keep the belts against Fly and the Bailey Brothers on 26th January, against Matt Hocking, Joe Benning and Jonnie Perez on 4th March and against Fly and Smith & Singh on 4th April 2011. The diary's own title records list the team as "Johnson, Remus & Callum". They keep the Trios titles on the 4th and 18th May and 4th July 2011 tour shows and lose them to The Firm at Summernova on 12th August, Kid Arachnid pinning Nelson Callum.

identity.note: An exact name match with another promotion's own tag team or stable. Each is filed as its own per-promotion row, never merged.

name: Cattley & Singh

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-new-year-old-rivalries-2011-01-p279-282.html.

caption: Jean Cattley and Kashmir Singh, put together on 12th January 2011 at New Year, Old Rivalries: Smith & Singh have earned a Tag Team title shot, the Canadian Blondes have injured Brandon Smith, and Singh, noting that the contract named no individuals, brings in Cattley as his partner. They beat the Blondes for the belts, Cattley pinning Flash Savage with the Mood Swing, and keep them against Antonio & Raphael at Leap Into The Unknown in February, the Blondes at Third Time's The Charm in March and Thrash and Firebird at April Showers; in April 2011 Cattley tells the narrator and Rip Chord that he is leaving for the SWF. The diary's own title records list the reign as "Cattley & Singh January 2011 3". They lose the Tag Team titles to the Canadian Blondes at Spring Fever on 23rd April 2011, Oscar Golden pinning Cattley; Casey Valentine and Antonio attack them and Erik Strong makes his return, and Cattley then loses a Loser Leaves Town match to Valentine and leaves MAW.

name: The Young Americans

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/month-2011-04-p326-327.html.

caption: Joe Benning and Matt Hocking, a team that the narrator says FCW built up before Benning left that company, billed together for April Showers on 12th April 2011, where Ford & Speed beat them with a Cross Armbreaker on Benning. They challenge the Canadian Blondes for the Tag Team titles on 12th May 2011, lose a trios match with Amazing Fire Fly to The Triple Threat on 18th May and to the West Texas Peacekeepers on 18th July, beat Curtis Jenkins and Raphael and Team XDW in August, lose to the Blondes on 4th September and to Valentine and Antonio at Back To School, and are Fumihiro Ota's partners in the Summernova six-man. They lose the Tag Team title three-way at Fall Of The King on 26th September 2011 and to the Dark Raptors at Eleventh Hour on 12th November.

name: The Second Sons

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-spring-fever-2011-04-p333-337.html.

caption: Erik Strong, Antonio and Casey Valentine, who name themselves at Spring Fever on 23rd April 2011 after Casey Valentine's Loser Leaves Town win over Jean Cattley, telling Cattley that they are the men who should be in charge of the company now. Jay Chord refuses to join them and warns them to change the name, and the narrator's e-mails tell Jay to think about what "Second Sons" could mean in the company. They feud with Steve Flash's new Firm through the summer: Strong and Chord beat Flash and Kid Arachnid on 12th May, Valentine and Antonio beat Randy Bumfhole and Arachnid on 26th May, the three-match series at High Noon on 12th June ends one win each and a time-limit draw, Flash beats Valentine again at Summer Showdown and Antonio at Hotter Than Hot, where the Sons ambush Flash and Bumfhole after the bell, and Antonio and Strong lose to Flash and Bumfhole at Beach Blast. Jay Chord, Valentine and Antonio, billed as the Second Sons, beat Fumihiro Ota and the Young Americans at Summernova on 12th August, and Valentine and Antonio beat the Young Americans at Back To School; in September Strong tells the narrator that he has an offer to go back up north. With Jay Chord and Erik Strong gone, Antonio and Casey Valentine are joined by Cameron Vessey, on loan from USPW, at All The Leaves Are Brown on 12th October 2011, where the three jump Chance Fortune and Zimmy Bumfhole; they win the Trios titles from The Firm at Where It All Begins Again on 26th October, Valentine pinning Kid Arachnid, and lose them when Rip Chord retires the belts at Eleventh Hour on 12th November, JD Morgan throwing out all three in the battle royal for the All Action title. Antonio and Valentine lose to Smith & Singh for the Tag Team titles at Remember November, beat the West Texas Peacekeepers at End Of Days, and lose to Wanda Fish and Jared Johnson on 5th January 2012; Valentine says that the pair will rely on themselves. In the diary's pages from March to May 2012 they beat the Internet Favourites at Third Time's The Charm, lose a Tag Team title match to Smith & Singh at March Madness, win a four-team match at April Showers on 5th April to earn a title shot, win the Spring Fever three-way and lose the title match to Smith & Singh at May The Force Be With You on 5th May. In the diary's pages from June to September 2012 they lose the High Noon three-way on 5th June, beat Team Honor at Summer Showdown and Smith & Singh at Beach Blast, and lose at South East Grand Parade with Black Eagle and in the three-way at Iron on 12th August.

name: The Dark Raptors

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-mother-may-i-2011-05-p349-353.html.

caption: Firebird and Black Eagle, billed as The Dark Raptors in a three-way for the Tag Team titles against Smith & Singh and the Canadian Blondes at Mother, May I? on 26th May 2011, where Oscar Golden crotches Firebird on the top rope and the Blondes retain. As Firebird and Black Eagle they lose to Aaron Andrews and Kirk Jameson at Spring Fever; after the three-way they stand with JD Morgan and the converted Masked Patriot, presented as Providence, as the four men who "have something greater". They beat the Young Americans at Eleventh Hour on 12th November 2011, where Firebird announces that they are the champions-elect, lose the Tag Team title three-way at Season's Beatings when Singh pins Firebird, and beat Lassana Makutsi and Amazing Fire Fly at End Of Days. They lose to KC Glenn and Randy Bumfhole at All Or Nothing on 12th February 2012, when Bumfhole pins Black Eagle; Eagle's spinal surgery that follows leaves Firebird on a singles run and the tag division with more heel teams than face ones. In the diary's pages from June to September 2012 Firebird and Black Eagle win the Tag Team titles from Smith & Singh at Summer Showdown on 12th June as part of The Fallen, keep them against the West Texas Peacekeepers on 9th July, the XX Factor on 5th August and Spectrum Infinity on 12th August, and lose them to Team Honor at Back To School on 5th September, when Eagle taps out.

name: The Quest

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-maw-on-tour-2011-06-25-p366.html.

caption: A tour-show team of two of the June 2011 signings: the diary never prints the line-up, but the signing notes pair Daredevil Aero and Fearless Blue against the others in the XDW storyline, and Aero is the man Oscar Golden pins in the team's Tag Team title challenge at Iron on 26th August, a match the narrator calls "squashy McSquash". They lose to Team XDW on 25th June and 15th September, with the West Texas Peacekeepers to Team XDW on 1st September and in a four-team match with them to VIP Wallace and Jefferson Stardust on 18th August. The pair is released with the rest of the third brand on 1st November 2011.

name: Team XDW

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/month-2011-06-p363-367.html.

caption: Extreme Deluxe, Xavier Reckless and Super Sonic, the XDW survivors who, in the storyline the narrator describes in June 2011, assault MAW with backyard and hardcore tactics, with Daredevil Aero and Fearless Blue trying to stop them. They beat The Quest on 25th June and 15th September and the West Texas Peacekeepers and The Quest on 1st September, lose to the Young Americans on 11th August and are squashed by Smith & Singh at Iron; billed as Team XDW II they lose to the Internet Favourites on 11th July, and with the Young Americans they lose a three-way to the West Texas Peacekeepers on 18th July. The group is released with the rest of the third brand on 1st November 2011.

name: The West Texas Peacekeepers

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/month-2011-06-p363-367.html.

caption: Marshall Dillon and Bradley Blaze, two manly Texas cowboys whom the narrator pairs off in June 2011 because they are so alike. They debut on the 25th June tour show with a win over Simon Ice and Curtis Jenkins, challenge the Canadian Blondes for the Tag Team titles at Summer Showdown on 26th June, lose a Trios-title tour match to The Triple Threat with Amazing Fire Fly on 4th July, beat the Young Americans and Team XDW on 18th July, lose to VIP Wallace and Jefferson Stardust on 18th August, to Team XDW with The Quest on 1st September and to Ford & Speed's Fallen Chances at Iron. They lose to Ford & Speed at Fall Of The King on 26th September 2011, to Lockdown at Remember November and on 5th January 2012, to the Canadian Blondes at Season's Beatings and to the Second Sons at End Of Days. They lose to Ford & Speed at March Madness on 12th March 2012 and are in the four-team match at April Showers on 5th April. In the diary's pages from June to August 2012 they lose the High Noon three-way on 5th June, challenge the Dark Raptors for the Tag Team titles at Great Lakes Grand Parade on 9th July, and lose to Ford & Speed at Summernova on 5th August.

name: Lockdown

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-eleventh-hour-2011-11-p452-458.html.

caption: Shady K and Knuckles, the former SWF team the tew.com notes call Death Row, whom Aaron Andrews buys as his "insurance policy" and introduces at Eleventh Hour on 12th November 2011 as men who are motivated only by cold, hard cash. They beat the Internet Favourites that night, Team OMGsplosion at Farewell Tour on 22nd November, and, with Knuckles winning the All Action title, the West Texas Peacekeepers at Remember November; at Season's Beatings on 12th December they break up Kirk Jameson's Invitational qualifier and beat Jonnie Perez and Bradford Peverell, at End Of Days they ambush Randy Bumfhole and Fumihiro Ota, and on 5th January 2012 they beat the Peacekeepers. Brandon Smith, Kashmir Singh, Greg Ford and Marc Speed agree to put the tag champions' differences aside; at The Rip Chord Invitational on 12th January they are charged by all four men at the start of the three-way for the Tag Team titles and put out of the match and, Aaron Andrews says, out of the promotion.

identity.note: An exact name match with another promotion's own tag team or stable. Each is filed as its own per-promotion row, never merged.

name: The Fabulous Bumfholes

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-eleventh-hour-2011-11-p452-458.html.

caption: Randy Bumfhole and his brother Zimmy, who come down the aisle together in America for the first time in over a year at Eleventh Hour on 12th November 2011 for Zimmy's last night with the company for a while. They beat Aaron Andrews and Primus Allen in a twenty-five-minute match in which Andrews keeps trying to avoid Randy, until Allen hauls him into the ring and Randy pins the Heavyweight champion with the Bumfhole Buster.

name: Team OMGsplosion

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-eleventh-hour-2011-11-p452-458.html.

caption: Hugh de Aske and Fumihiro Ota, a pirate and a ninja put together at Eleventh Hour on 12th November 2011 when Hugh's new "wench" offers Hugh as a partner for the silent Ota and the Internet Favourites' reaction is "O-M-G-splosion". They beat Ford & Speed that night with a Cut-throat Driver on Greg Ford, and lose to Lockdown at Farewell Tour on 22nd November, after which Hugh leaves for the SWF; the narrator says in December that the team should have toppled the Canadian Blondes.

name: Team Honor

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/month-2012-06-p561-562.html.

caption: Lassana Makutsi and Jared Johnson, a newly formed pairing the narrator says have great chemistry teaming together. They lose to Always Breakin' Hollywood at South East Madness on 9th June 2012, to the Second Sons at Summer Showdown on 12th June, and then, with Randy Bumfhole, beat Black Eagle and the Second Sons at South East Grand Parade on 9th August, Johnson scoring with an MDK Powerbomb; at Iron on 12th August they win a three-way against the Second Sons and Always Breakin' Hollywood, and at Back To School on 5th September, against the Dark Raptors, whom they were not much fancied to beat, Johnson matches the Dark Raptors hold for hold, Makutsi takes to the air, and an MDK Powerbomb and a Carolina Crossface make Black Eagle tap out to win the Tag Team titles.

name: Always Breakin' Hollywood

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-high-noon-2012-06-p559-561.html.

caption: Primus Allen and Lenny Brown, introduced by Haley Buck at High Noon on 5th June 2012 as her latest clients, "the future of professional wrestling, the essence of glamour", who spell out their initials as "A... B... H..." and say they are living large, "takin' what we wanna and winning every damn time". They beat the West Texas Peacekeepers and the Canadian Blondes in a three-way debut as a full-time team (Brown crushing Marshall Dillon with The Star Treatment), Team Honor at South East Madness, Smith & Singh at Hotter Than Hot and the XX Factor at Back To School on 5th September, and lose the Iron three-way to Team Honor; at Iron they offer Rudy Velasquez a place in their manager's new group and are turned away.

name: Spectrum Infinity

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-great-lakes-grand-parade-2012-07-p582-584.html.

caption: Blue Shift and Scarlet Strike, a masked team managed by Dawn, introduced in a video of a club at Great Lakes Grand Parade on 9th July 2012: "they party hard, but they wrestle harder". The narrator calls their debut loss to the Canadian Blondes as low-key as it gets; they beat the Blondes at Summernova on 5th August, a match the narrator says exists to give screen time and a win to teams who have not seen much of either, and lose the Tag Team title match to the Dark Raptors at Iron on 12th August.

name: The XX Factor

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-hotter-than-hot-2012-07-p577-579.html.

caption: Thea Davis and Jaime Quine, a pairing introduced at Hotter Than Hot on 5th July 2012 with an open challenge that Providence and Father Johan take up. They say they are not trying to prove women better than men, and that if they win the Tag Team titles they will not be "dying the straps pink"; they lose a Tag Team title challenge to the Dark Raptors at Summernova on 5th August and to Always Breakin' Hollywood at Back To School on 5th September, where interviewer Jenny asks whether they can see themselves winning in MAW and Davis says they hope to make up for their size in speed and skill.

name: Knights Templar

tenures.source: The diary's own posts bill the team from /promotions/maw-10-simple-rules/archive/show-beach-blast-2012-07-p585-589.html.

caption: The face stable that Kirk Jameson names at Beach Blast on 12th July 2012: because it is on a crusade of sorts and people call its members white knights, they are the Knights Templar, a name Jameson says a benefactor suggested after Bradford Peverell said that people need a symbol to rally behind; Jameson says they are not a cult. At Summer Showdown on 12th June Peverell, KC Glenn and Donnie J, who says he will help only in the ring, agree to stand united with Jameson against The Fallen; JD Morgan agrees at Great Lakes Grand Parade on 9th July to help them when he is in trouble without signing up to anything, and the benefactor who funds the help they receive, Rich Money, is brought to the ring by Jameson at Summernova on 5th August; the diary does not print a full roll.
